one_liner: Enterprise messaging platform enabling businesses to communicate with customers globally via the WhatsApp Cloud API.
auth_notes: Uses Facebook Graph API token authentication and system user access tokens.
gate_notes: Requires Meta Business Verification and app review for full production access, though a sandbox is available for testing.
verdict_reason: WhatsApp Business provides a robust Cloud API for messaging and templates, but requires Meta Business verification and app setup.

extras.rate_limit_note: Tiered messaging limits based on quality rating and phone number tier (e.g. 1k, 10k, 100k+ messages per day).

evidence.quote: This documentation is for developers building on the WhatsApp Business Platform. ... This guide helps developers quickly get started with the WhatsApp Cloud API.
